title: il Giornale says its Instagram account was targeted by an attempted hacker attack
summary: Italian newspaper il Giornale says in its own article that its official Instagram account was the target of an attempted hacker attack. The account was removed from the platform for a short period, the newsroom noticed and recovered it, and it is active again. The paper says it does not know who was behind the attempt or why.
plain: Italian newspaper il Giornale says someone tried to hack its Instagram account. The account vanished briefly, the newsroom got it back, and the paper does not know who was responsible.
exec: A newspaper reports a brief loss of its Instagram account after an attempted hack; the paper says it recovered it and does not know who was behind it.
